facts.fact: 考前 Max 对 Milo 隐瞒威胁短信——不能证明是 Peyton 发的，也不想让 white knight 替她开战。
facts.anchor: the words remain trapped inside my head where they should be.

facts.fact: 她推断 Peyton 目击脸颊吻后开战：短信的时机掐在考试前——她知道我们昨天学了一下午。
facts.anchor: She must’ve seen him kiss my cheek last night and gone on the warpath

facts.fact: 恐惧脑补跑偏：她以为是更衣室裸照外流，甚至想好要用 SVU 里学到的法律（传播未成年人裸照是重罪）反击。
facts.anchor: Does everyone have a naked picture of me from the showers?!

facts.fact: 真相更毒：几十张照片全是她母亲的入狱档案照——不是她的裸照，是她的血统。
facts.anchor: They’re all of my mother. Every single one.

facts.fact: 附件是母亲每次因卖淫被捕的警方报告，最后一页红字：Like mother, like daughter——直击她的心脏。
facts.anchor: police reports from every time my mother was arrested for solicitation and prostitution.

facts.fact: Reds 五人胜利巡游：Amber、Jordan 轮番羞辱，Peyton 提到「有名声值得保护的家庭」。
facts.anchor: “If that were me, I’d never show my face in this town again,”

facts.fact: Sydney 的收尾判决：换作是我妈是脏婊子，我唯一能做的就是自杀——五人爆笑而去。
Max 在走廊瘫倒崩溃，无人问津——「Reds 刚杀死了我，没人看见地上的血」。
facts.anchor: The Fairhope Reds have just killed me, and no one seems to notice the blood staining the hallway floor.

facts.fact: Milo 赶到，一言不发把她抱紧——不问、不安慰、不许诺复仇，只是不放。
facts.anchor: He just holds me while I shatter in his arms.

facts.fact: 在他怀里她重新学会呼吸——Honeysuckle 的气味成了她的急救信号。
facts.anchor: And somehow… I manage to breathe again.
